messages.subject: Version 1.2.6 released
parts:
The version 1.2.6 of the Vim-R-plugin was released:

http://www.vim.org/scripts/script.php?script_id=2628

The changes are:
  • Improve support for lazy load objects in the Object Browser. 
  • Remove option vimrplugin_vim_window (use $WINDOWID instead). 
  • Fix bug that prevented GVim 64 bit of finding libVimR.dll.
It is necessary to install a new version of the vimcom package:

http://www.lepem.ufc.br/jaa/vimcom.html
